text:
Asking rents in Duisburg stand at a median of 8.49 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.9% on the year and +27.6% over five years. That ranks Duisburg #34 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 45% above the 2022 average contract rent of 5.84 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 509 € a month in cold rent, 14.5% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 35 days and 19% are gone within a week; with 2.4% market-active vacancy and +0.9% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 8.95 €/m² (+5.4%), with an 80% range of 8.71 to 9.08 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
